crossRefs.note: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came…
and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these…
He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to…
They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes…
They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was…
When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done…
But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

parallels.note: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these…
They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

translations.web: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translations.bsb: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
translations.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
translations.asv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
